The MacBook Pro OLED is one of the biggest MacBook releases in recent years.

sources.why: general laptop hub guide, not iPad Pro specific
sources.evidence: Nearly all of the USB-C hubs I tested support passthrough charging. That means if your laptop or tablet only charges via USB, you don't have to take up another port
